title: Agent-ready skills
description:
Promoted from: orbit/cards/0011-agent-ready-skills.yaml

Goal: Two skills shipped (/finetype-pipeline, /finetype-cli) — agents complete full pipeline, not just profile

## Current state (cycle 3)

Both skills already exist on disk:
- .claude/skills/finetype-pipeline/SKILL.md (3-step pipeline correctly described, no behavioural-fixture artefact)
- .claude/skills/finetype-cli/SKILL.md (banner stale at v0.6.12; multiple flag-level divergences from the v0.6.19 binary surface)

This iteration's delta:
1. Refresh /finetype-cli — bump banner to v0.6.19 and bring the command/flag inventory current against the v0.6.19 binary, including the hidden subcommands `generate` and `check`.
2. Add a standalone drift-check script (`scripts/verify-cli-skill-coverage.sh`) that diffs the skill inventory against the live `finetype --help` surface.
3. Document /finetype-pipeline behaviour with a manual checklist (`.claude/skills/finetype-pipeline/CHECKLIST.md`) enumerating the three commands the agent must invoke in sequence.
4. Make AC-04's "no setup" claim explicitly testable by inspection.

## Scope constraints

- **Target runtime:** Claude Code skill loader (`.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`). Multi-runtime portability (Cursor, Aider, Codex, Cline) is out of scope.
- **CI integration:** out of scope for this bead. The drift script ships as an invokable artefact; wiring it into `.github/workflows/release.yml` (or any release-time gate) is tracked as a follow-up bead.
- **No new MADR.** The work conforms to the post-0070/0071 surface; no architectural change.

## Hidden-subcommand handling

`generate` and `check` are functional but absent from top-level `finetype --help`. The drift script must enumerate them via a curated allowlist baked into the script, not from `--help` parsing alone. Treating them as obsolete because they're not in `--help` would silently delete real documentation.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] ac-01: Pipeline skill guides full v0.6.19 workflow — invoking /finetype-pipeline on a CSV walks the agent through profile → profile -o json-schema → validate --db --table (the post-MADR-0070/0071 three-step pipeline). No reference to the removed `load` verb. Verified by `.claude/skills/finetype-pipeline/CHECKLIST.md` — a manual checklist that enumerates the three commands the agent must invoke in sequence on a representative CSV.
- [x] ac-02: CLI skill content current against v0.6.19 — banner names v0.6.19 and the documented command/flag inventory matches the v0.6.19 binary surface across all clap subcommands (visible plus the hidden subcommands `generate` and `check`) and per-subcommand flag tables. Verified by inspection of `.claude/skills/finetype-cli/SKILL.md` against `finetype <subcommand> --help` output for the full enumerated set; the cycle-2 review identified at least these divergences to close: missing `validate --db/--table/--append/--lenient`, wrong `--enum-threshold` default (binary=32), wrong `--model-type` default (binary=multi-branch), stale `--sharp-only` flag, missing `profile --stats`.
- [x] ac-03: CLI skill drift harness — a standalone script `scripts/verify-cli-skill-coverage.sh` diffs the documented inventory in `.claude/skills/finetype-cli/SKILL.md` against `finetype --help` and per-subcommand `--help` (covering hidden subcommands `generate` and `check` from a curated allowlist baked into the script), exiting non-zero on missing or obsolete entries. Wiring into release CI is out of scope for this bead and tracked as a follow-up; ship the invokable script.
- [x] ac-04: Zero setup required (Claude Code) — both skills load via the .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md convention with no requirement to install an MCP server, configure API keys, or set runtime environment variables. Verified by inspection — neither SKILL.md instructs the user to run `claude mcp add ...`, define `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (or similar), or perform external runtime configuration. Documentation references to FineType's own `mcp` subcommand are not setup requirements and do not violate this AC.
close_reason: drive completed: agent-ready skills aligned with v0.6.19 surface; drift harness ships; CHECKLIST.md ships; PR #63
